LanguageData.Petitions_Settings_ThresholdMultiplier_T: Multiplies how much grievance pressure a colonist needs before petitioning. Higher means fewer petitions.
LanguageData.Petitions_Settings_PressureDecay_Tip: How much grievance pressure fades each day while its cause is gone.
LanguageData.Petitions_Settings_PawnCooldown: Days before the same colonist petitions again: {0}
LanguageData.Petitions_Settings_GrievanceCooldown: Days before the same colonist raises the same grievance again: {0}
LanguageData.Petitions_Settings_Expiry: Days before an unanswered petition counts as ignored: {0}
LanguageData.Petitions_Settings_EnableDisgruntled_Tip: At resentment 55 or more, a colonist becomes disgruntled and works at 85% speed until it drops below 45.
LanguageData.Petitions_Settings_EnableUltimatum: Ultimatums: very resentful colonists may leave
LanguageData.Petitions_Settings_EnableUltimatum_Tip: At resentment 80 or more, a colonist gives an ultimatum. If their resentment is still 70 or more after 3 days and no promise to them is pending, they give up and leave the colony.
LanguageData.Petitions_Letter_Intro: {PAWN_nameDef} has come forward with a petition about {GRIEVANCE}. [PAWN_pronoun] is asking for {DEMAND}.
LanguageData.Petitions_Letter_AcceptRemedy: Accept: promise to fix this within {DAYS} days. The promise is kept once these thoughts have been gone for {HOLD} day(s) for every signer. If it isn't, the promise is broken.
LanguageData.Petitions_Letter_AcceptCessation: Accept: promise to stop this for {DAYS} days. If any signer learns of it happening again in that time, the promise is broken.
LanguageData.Petitions_Letter_Persuade: Persuade: {NEGOTIATOR_nameDef} tries to talk the signers out of it. Chance of success: {CHANCE}. If it fails, they resent it more than a plain refusal.
LanguageData.Petitions_Letter_PersuadeNoNegotiator: Persuade: nobody is available to negotiate.
LanguageData.Petitions_Letter_Reject: Reject: the signers' mood and resentment suffer, and they think less of the negotiator.
LanguageData.Petitions_Letter_Expiry: If you don't answer within {DAYS} days, the petition counts as ignored.
LanguageData.Petitions_NoNegotiator: Nobody who isn't a signer can negotiate right now.
LanguageData.Petitions_Message_Accepted: You promised {PAWN_nameDef} to deal with {GRIEVANCE} within {DAYS} days.
LanguageData.Petitions_Message_PersuasionFailed: {NEGOTIATOR_nameDef} failed to talk {PAWN_nameDef} out of the petition. The signers feel brushed off.
LanguageData.Petitions_Message_Ignored: {PAWN_nameDef}'s petition went unanswered and was ignored.
LanguageData.Petitions_PromiseKept_Text: The colony kept its promise to {PAWN_nameDef} about {GRIEVANCE}. The signers feel heard, and their resentment eases.
LanguageData.Petitions_PromiseBroken_Text: The colony broke its promise to {PAWN_nameDef} about {GRIEVANCE}. The signers won't forget this soon.
LanguageData.Petitions_Tab_NoGrievances: No colonist has a grievance right now.
